intro: Football is Vietnam's favourite sport, and every big win brings millions of fans out onto the streets on motorbikes.

chapters.title: Football fever
text: Vietnam has won the ASEAN Championship (the AFF Cup) several times. When the under-23 team reached the Asian final in 2018, cities erupted in celebration.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: Hoàng Xuân Vinh won Vietnam's first Olympic gold in shooting in 2016. Martial arts such as Vovinam are popular, and the women's football team played at the 2023 World Cup.
